title: AAX described flexible and fixed crypto savings products
notes: First-party AAX Academy description of flexible savings and fixed-duration savings products, including advertised APY examples. Marketing examples do not establish asset segregation, customer legal title, underlying deployment, or principal protection.

title: AAX described the AAB Plus interest-earning service
notes: First-party description of fixed and flexible AAB-token savings rewards. It is preserved as a distinct token-linked yield product rather than merged with every AAX savings balance.

title: AAX withdrawal freeze and reported police liquidity findings
notes: Reports the November withdrawal suspension, AAX's system-upgrade explanation and later police statements about liquidity. Operator and police explanations remain separately attributed.

title: Hong Kong police arrests in AAX-related case
notes: Reports arrests, frozen accounts, complaints and police allegations. No conviction, final loss total or liability finding is inferred.

title: Singapore High Court grounds for winding up AAX Asia and AAX Singapore
notes: Primary court source for the winding-up orders, effective date, inability to pay debts, lack of available assets and appointment of a liquidator for multi-jurisdictional investigation.

title: AAX customer records and contracting-entity uncertainty
notes: The court records that customer records were missing and customers did not know which AAX entities they contracted with. This supports an unclear terms and creditor-entity classification, not one uniform ownership conclusion.
